difficulty_reason: Prove the Picard functor is separated when the geometric fibres are integral: reduce via the valuative criterion to killing a class a in Picardfunctor_{X/R}(R) trivial on the generic fibre; lift a to an invertible module L through the gerbe Picardstack -> Picardfunctor (surjective flat, lift-valuation-ring lemma) after extending R; set K = Rf_*L and M = Rf_*L^{tensor -1}, perfect complexes whose formation commutes with base change; the jump functions beta_{K,0} and beta_{M,0} equal 1 at the generic point (proper geometrically reduced global sections) hence are >= 1 at the closed point by upper semicontinuity; the characterize-trivial-Pic lemma forces L|_{X_0} trivial, so beta_{K,0}(0) = 1; the lift-pseudo-coherent lemma represents K as R -> R^{oplus beta_{K,1}(0)} -> ... with zero first map (since beta_{K,0}(eta) = 1), splitting K = R plus tau_{>=1}K; base-change commutation yields a global section s of L nonvanishing on X_0, and s: O_X -> L is an isomorphism of invertible sheaves.
